name: resume-builder
description: 专业中文技术简历生成器，海军蓝咨询风固定模板，一次产出 HTML/DOCX/PDF 三格式 2 页 A4 简历，支持指标加粗、项目 banner、子模块横幅、强制分页等排版能力，适用于互联网/大厂技术岗求职简历制作。
author: lugezuishuai

external_resources: CJK font (PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei / Noto Sans CJK SC)

features: Single JSON data source generates HTML, DOCX, and PDF in one run
Project banners and light-blue sub-section banners for visual hierarchy
Inline **bold** markers for quantified metrics and key scope
Optional page-break control per project for precise 2-page layout
Example data and full schema documentation included
